status_codes.D: decided by a registered prospective test (pending)

claims.claim: Head change under a policy in N2's unit (headline, tile tW, start note)
claims.wording_en: Head change, policy minus baseline, in this model: the mean over N2's 84 Yunlin monitoring wells, each in its own screened layer (N2's scoring unit; built into the page as an aggregate, payload n2Unit). Tile range line: 'direction supported (design-time, R0 recipe); within-window anomaly response decided by N2 not before 2028-01-15; level report-only'. Direction supported by the registered masked 2016-18 refit in Yunlin (step C, N1P.C_heads_yunlin), scored on the R0 recipe (stage3_datum_gate_cwa) on a design-time window and carried to the page model only by a post-hoc, model-only comparison (science-05 transfer file); the 2015 drought spring (G1) agrees but mixes canal water and rain with pumping. Size likely too small (slopes reported, not gated; no calibrated correction factor follows). N2 decides the within-window response to recorded Yunlin pumping anomalies: 'response supported' needs the 90 % interval of the per-well-demeaned anomaly slope to exclude 0, the slope inside [1/1.5, 1.5] and RMSE(PR) < RMSE(ZR); a 'not supported' result cannot separate the model from its X1 forcing; the level is report-only; scored no earlier than 2028-01-15. Carrying it to a class lever is a linear, model-only transfer.
claims.notes: Model output, recomputed in the page build from the forward run (cut30 / retire_aqua at Dec 2032): N2 unit +1.19 / +1.41 m (84 of 84 registered Yunlin wells found; station ids from the registered prospective predictions.csv, county code 09; cells and layers from the calibration wells, the same mapping as twin.coverage). Layer-2 context kept in the tile's detail line: named-Yunlin-township cell mean +1.37 m, fan average +0.90 m (about 20 % Changhua spillover). The S part rests on R0 tests only; G1 is consistent context, not the pumping-response test. The page carries no station id, cell or layer: n2Unit holds only the per-year means.

The 2023-26 coverage is an after-the-fact measurement already published; it did not drive the rename (U7). The registered synthetic coverage tests A1.coverage_confirm.v1 and A1r2.coverage3_confirm.v1 concern recovery on synthetic data, not this band's coverage of observations, so they are context, not support.
